entries.title: Dracodia / articulated claws — full final main life
entries.note: Native Furious full5330HP final-main-life checkpoint, all preceding life pools cleared before recording. First22s withhold fire to show the articulation. Input-only invulnerable pilot thereafter; no recorder HP/phase/clock edits. Source-preserving shoulder/elbow/wrist poses: edge-to-center left/right rakes, coiled guard, protected background retreat, jump and two alternating physical claw strikes. Real blade-alpha contact, current part damage/targets, break cancellation and native Luminaire/copy/ending owners retained. Existing design and crescent blades; no new generation credits.
